task_summary: Detect BGP route oscillation and valley-free route leaks in an Azure Virtual WAN topology, then evaluate which proposed solutions resolve each issue.
decomposition_rationale: The task has three distinct functional concerns: (1) loading/parsing BGP topology data with proper type handling, (2) detecting oscillation cycles and route leak violations using graph/policy algorithms, and (3) evaluating natural-language solution descriptions against resolution criteria. These map cleanly to 3 skills with clear boundaries.

skills.name: evo-bgp-data-loader
skills.description: Loads and normalizes BGP topology JSON files from /app/data/, handling the critical Python JSON integer-key coercion pitfall. Provides robust file I/O with encoding and error handling.
skills.responsibility: Load all input JSON files (route.json, preferences.json, local_pref.json, relationships.json, topology.json, route_events.json, possible_solutions.json) and normalize data types, especially converting string dictionary keys back to integers for ASN lookups.
dr_sections: 5. Data Loading Patterns and Data Pipeline
5.1 JSON File Loading from a Fixed Path
5.2 Handling Integer Keys in Python JSON (The Pitfall)

skills.name: evo-bgp-anomaly-detection
skills.description: Detects BGP route oscillation via preference cycle detection in directed graphs and identifies route leaks by evaluating valley-free routing constraints against route events.
skills.responsibility: Implement DFS-based cycle detection on the routing preference graph to find oscillation cycles, and apply Gao-Rexford valley-free rules to route events to classify route leaks. Produces deterministically ordered cycle lists and standardized leak report objects.
dr_sections: 2. BGP Route Oscillation Detection via Routing Preference Cycles
2.1 Formal Definition of BGP Route Oscillation
2.2 Detecting Cycles in a Directed Preference Graph
2.4 Python Implementation of Route Oscillation Detection
3. BGP Valley-Free Routing and Route Leak Detection
3.2 Definition and Detection of a Route Leak
3.3 Python Implementation for Classifying Route Events
3.4 Standard Format for Reporting Route Leaks

skills.name: evo-bgp-solution-evaluator
skills.description: Evaluates natural-language solution descriptions to determine if each resolves BGP oscillation and/or route leaks, then assembles and writes the final structured JSON report.
skills.responsibility: Use regex pattern matching to classify each proposed solution as resolving oscillation (breaks preference cycle or disables peering link), resolving route leaks (enforces export/ingress filtering, community tagging, routing intent, or disables peering), or neither. Assemble the complete oscillation_report.json output with all required fields.
dr_sections: 7. Common Pitfalls and Edge Cases to Avoid
